checks.explanation: The selection disclosure is on page 1 and the itemized prices begin on page 1, so it is on the same page as the prices it accompanies.
The basic services includes text lists arrangements conference, shelter of remains, notices, permits and authorizations, and coordination with cemetery, crematory or other third parties.
The list shows only the basic services fee as a mandatory overhead charge and no additional mandatory fee for staff, facilities or handling.
The embalming disclosure is on page 1 and the embalming price of $795 is also on page 1, so they are on the same page.
No text states that embalming is needed for direct cremation, immediate burial, or a closed-casket service without viewing.
The alternative container disclosure is on page 2 and the direct cremation range of $1,595 to $1,945 is also on page 2.
Direct cremation is offered with a purchaser-provided container, fiberboard container, or unfinished wood box, with no statement that a casket is needed.
The direct cremation description mentions transportation to crematory and cremation, and no separate crematory cash advance charge is listed.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial all have their own priced lines, and the unpriced insurance-claim line appears as its own line item.
The list contains only required items with single prices for forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial and no optional combination package.
No text asserts that a cemetery, crematory or law requires a purchase beyond the wording of the required disclosures themselves.
No text claims that any product delays decomposition long-term or protects the body from gravesite substances.
No other wording undercuts the required disclosures, and the disclosures appear in clear full sentences.
